data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1492 reported an opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 134.858m at 1 January 2020 and recorded a net release on prior years (driven principally by the positive development of the 2019 year-of-account offset slightly by adverse movements on earlier years), with a net prior year improvement equivalent to a GBP 17.876m release. The favourable movement reflects benign large loss experience in 2020, active portfolio remediation and reinsurance protection; Covid-19 had a limited quantified impact of about GBP 3.5m. Named catastrophe events were small in aggregate relative to reserves. The closure of older years (2018 & prior) by RITC is noted and some older-year volatility remains possible.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2020 year of account has developed favourably to date with a Gross Earned Loss Ratio at 45.2% and the Syndicate has benefited from a benign year with minimal large loss activity.

The 2018 & prior years of account is closing by Reinsurance to close (RITC) after 36 months with a distributable profit of GBP 9,800,000 (2017 & prior years of account - collectable loss GBP 23,857,000).
Limited financial impact of Covid-19 claims (GBP 3.5m of Gross and Net provision).

The 2018 & prior years of account distributable profit of GBP 9,800,000 consists of:  A profit of GBP 10,988,000 in respect of 2018 pure year of account.  A loss of GBP  (1,393,000) in respect of 2017 & prior years of accounts movements in 2020.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure derived from year-of-account breakdown (sum of non-current-year year-of-account results) reported on page 12. That breakdown is explicit but represents the year-of-account result (net basis) rather than a dedicated GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision' note; reconciliation between net and gross is not separately provided as a single gross prior-year movement line. A gross claims development triangle is present (pages ~71) and RITC of 2018 & prior is noted which can distort older-year comparisons.
